# Original synthetic draft outline, revision 2

This revised outline is independently authored for fixture design. It is not a
Queensland Health form and does not establish local template conformity.

## Scope and open questions

Keep the selected review process, analytical tools and authority separate.

## Accounts, contrary evidence and alternatives

Keep participant accounts, contrary material, source families and uncertainty.
Record alternative explanations explicitly; a blank document field does not
establish omitted care.

## Proposed findings and actions

Distinguish proposed findings, action implementation and effectiveness evidence.

## Review and external status

Retain unresolved authority, review decisions and the absence of submission.
